d:
Indulge in the magic of "Raat Akeli Thi," a soul-stirring romantic love song from the movie "Merry Christmas." Starring Katrina Kaif and Vijay Sethupathi, this enchanting track is set to the captivating music of Pritam. Arijit Singh lends their mesmerizing voice, and lyrics penned by Varun Grover, creating a perfect blend of romance and melody.
Song Details :
Song Name : Raat Akeli Thi
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singer - Arijit Singh
Lyrics - Varun Grover
Music - Pritam
Music Arranger and Programmer - Himonshu Parikh
